summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its second-quarter 2026 results. The filing reports a net result of €1,947 million, profit before tax up 23% year-on-year, and strong customer growth. ING also announced a strategic investment in Spanish wealth manager Singular Bank, but no specific terms were provided. The document is a routine earnings release with an accompanying strategic investment announcement lacking deal details, so it does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
